Landing on spike tiles (`u`/`v`) immediately ended the attempt. `UNDO` could revert the previous action as a recovery option. Planning relied on the provided landing previews (`left_landing`/`right_landing`) and corridor scan to identify safe landings and especially 'passage' columns that drop to a different y-level (new section), prioritizing those to make progress efficiently.
